character.description: small traditional Korean Gageodo hanseon fishing boat with a broad shallow flat-bottomed hull, blunt upright bow and stern, thick layered planks, one tall rectangular tan battened sail, compact working deck, and no Western, Chinese junk, or Japanese vessel silhouette

ne_sailing.action: north-east authored anchor, sailing with the tall rectangular sail fully raised

ne_moored.action: north-east authored direction, moored with mast standing and sail cloth and battens lowered and lashed near the lower mast

ne_fishing.action: north-east authored direction, active fishing with the accepted large deployed net and readable mesh
